guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 创建 Acepyr 账号
guide.description: 使用邮箱和密码注册 Acepyr，并验证邮箱。原文包含第三方邀请码 PW34SD3C2J，称邀请码仅在注册时生效；该代码不是本站推荐，也未核实为官方必填条件。是否填写、是否影响奖励，请先核对官方规则。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Sign up at Acepyr with an email and password, entering referral code PW34SD3C2J during registration. Codes only count when applied at signup. Verify your email to activate the account.

guide.title: 阅读法律文件并完成首次引导
guide.description: 首次登录会展示服务条款（Terms of Service）、隐私政策（Privacy Policy）和测试网积分说明（Testnet Points Notice），随后是引导问卷。原文称完成这些步骤及首次登录可获得 300 测试网 $ACEPYR。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Accept the Legal Documents and Complete Onboarding
guide.original_description: First login walks you through the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Testnet Points Notice, then the onboarding survey. Those steps plus your first sign-in pay 300 testnet $ACEPYR.

guide.title: 关联由你控制的钱包
guide.description: 在设置（Settings）中通过签名消息关联钱包，仅粘贴地址不算完成。原文称一个地址只能永久关联一个账号，关联可获得 500 测试网 $ACEPYR。签名前先核对消息内容及不可更改的绑定规则。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: In Settings, link a wallet by signing a message; a pasted address does not qualify. One address links to one account permanently, and linking pays 500 testnet $ACEPYR.

guide.title: 加入主网等候名单
guide.description: 原文称加入等候名单需验证钱包持有至少当前门槛（现为 $10）的资产，读取 Base、Ethereum、Arbitrum、Optimism、Polygon 和 BSC 余额；原生币和主要稳定币计入，不会把资金发送给 Acepyr。加入可获得 1,000 测试网 $ACEPYR，前 10,000 个合格账号可在上线时获得 $5，并激活邀请关系。余额门槛及奖励须核对官方最新规则。原文的交易所推广和跨链组件广告已省略。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The most productive click on the platform. Joining needs a proven wallet holding at least the current minimum, now $10, read live across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and BSC. Native coins and major stablecoins count, and nothing is sent to Acepyr, so balances you already hold for Base , Arbitrum or Optimism farming clear the check. Joining pays 1,000 testnet $ACEPYR, puts the first 10,000 qualifying accounts in line for $5 at launch, and activates whoever referred you. Short of the minimum? Pick up ETH or USDC on Bybit , then use the widget below to move it onto Base or another supported chain. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 参与实时涨跌市场
guide.description: 原文描述：选择五分钟内上涨（Up）或下跌（Down），由价格预言机结算。首次开仓奖励 250 测试网 $ACEPYR；首次限价单奖励 250；首次盈利平仓奖励 300。交易及签名要求待核实。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Trade the Live Up or Down Markets
guide.original_description: Take Up or Down on a five-minute window and let the price feed settle it. Three first-time achievements sit here: Open your first position: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Place your first limit order: 250 testnet $ACEPYR Close your first profitable position: 300 testnet $ACEPYR

guide.title: 了解每周竞赛
guide.description: 原文称竞赛免费、个人参赛、无需门票或最低余额；当周至少完成一笔结算交易才符合资格，并可分享 10,000 测试网 $ACEPYR 奖池。免费报名不代表交易无成本或无风险。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Entry is free and individual, with no ticket and no minimum balance. One settled trade that week makes you valid and earns a share of the 10,000 testnet $ACEPYR pool.

guide.title: 保持连续登录记录
guide.description: 原文称连续登录奖励分五档：2 天 50、3 天 100、7 天 300、14 天 500、30 天 1,000；每档奖励获得后永久保留。单位及规则请核对平台。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The streak pays at five rungs: 50 at two days, 100 at three, 300 at seven, 500 at fourteen and 1,000 at thirty. Each rung banks permanently.

guide.title: 生成个人邀请码
guide.description: 打开个人资料（Profile），进入邀请（Referrals）。原文称邀请码每月重置、积分不结转。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open Profile, then Referrals. Codes reset every month and points do not carry over.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
